name: provider-assessment-block-smoke-test
description: Read-only walk through an in-progress assessment block's Tests/Determination/Summary tabs -- general-purpose smoke check for any change touching provider assessment code (JsonHelper node-search, master-assessment.service.ts, assessment-test.component.ts, injury-prevention base class, etc.)
prerequisite: Run sonic-provider-admin-mohr.json (or any impersonate-tenant.json variant) first to land on a Provider portal with real seeded data.

steps.expect: Clinical Dashboard 'In Progress' list visible, N block(s) found

steps.target: Start button (2nd action icon) in any row -- NOT the '+' notes icon (1st icon) which opens an unrelated Add Note modal
steps.expect: Candidate block detail view opens, showing Current Block / All Blocks / General Notes & Documents tabs

steps.target: Tests tab in the left sub-nav
steps.expect: Review section with a document table + PDF preview pane (may show 'Missing PDF file 404' in console -- that's local S3 test-data noise, not a code bug)
Determination - <JobPreference> panel with an outcome dropdown, read-only unless you intentionally change it
Assessment/Outcome table listing Tests + Determination completion status

knownUnrelatedNoise: PDF.js 'Missing PDF file... 404' against mohr-local-dev S3 bucket -- local dev fixture data gap, not a regression.
'Error parsing user customisation: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input' -- pre-existing, unrelated to assessment code.

NG0100 ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError on _AddNoteTabComponent -- only fires if you click the notes '+' icon; pre-existing CD timing issue (this codebase is ~96% non-OnPush per the perf roadmap audit), not introduced by helper-consolidation work.

Two different candidate rows can show what looks like the same 'Adam Sandler' document pair under Tests -- appears to be shared/reused local seed data (same S3 object id in the PDF URL across candidates), not a caching bug worth chasing for this kind of change.
whatToWatchForOnARealRegression: TypeError / ReferenceError mentioning a helper class name (UtilsHelper, UrlHelper, CookieHelper, JsonHelper) -- would indicate a broken import after a libs/utils consolidation.
Assessment threshold/answer values rendering as blank or 'undefined' where they previously showed a value -- the likely visible symptom if JsonHelper's node-search logic broke.
Failure to land on the Provider/Tenant portal at all after impersonation, or a blank Team Dashboard -- would indicate the CookieHelper/UrlHelper pre-bootstrap wiring broke.
